business_confirmation_gates.title: Tenant / Organization Scoping Blocker
business_confirmation_gates.schema_fact: Database dump iredu lacks tenant_id, school_id, or organization_id columns across all 247 tables.
business_confirmation_gates.risk: Without tenant scoping, multi-campus deployments risk catastrophic cross-tenant data leakage.
business_confirmation_gates.rule: Live production context retrieval remains blocked until an authoritative organization/tenant partition rule is established. Audit evidence must store the resolved tenant/organization scope reference only when such scope has been authoritatively established. During synthetic/mock/documentation testing, synthetic/test scope identifiers only are used; do not invent a production tenant filter or identifier.

business_confirmation_gates.title: Active and Soft-Delete Semantics
business_confirmation_gates.schema_fact: Tables utilize heterogeneous active flags (int is_active, varchar(100) is_active, status varchar, disable_at).
business_confirmation_gates.risk: Naive queries may misinterpret string flags or include inactive/soft-deleted resources.
business_confirmation_gates.rule: Allowed values ('0','1','yes','no','active') must be explicitly confirmed for each source table before production queries.

business_confirmation_gates.title: Examination Subsystem Operational Authority
business_confirmation_gates.schema_fact: Schema contains parallel examination subsystems: CBSE exam subsystem vs Legacy exam_groups subsystem.
business_confirmation_gates.risk: Targeting the incorrect exam subsystem will generate plans incompatible with school workflows.
business_confirmation_gates.rule: Institutional stakeholders must designate which exam subsystem is authoritative for the curriculum.

business_confirmation_gates.title: SCHEDULING / EXAM RESOURCE PRODUCTION GATE: Physical Academic Resource Source Authority
business_confirmation_gates.schema_fact: MySQL iredu lacks room capacity, room equipment, room dimensions, or room type masters. Fields named room_no are unconstrained strings.
business_confirmation_gates.risk: Inferring room seating capacity or equipment from MySQL will produce invalid schedules.
business_confirmation_gates.rule: The unresolved academic room/equipment authority blocks production capabilities that require authoritative physical-resource scheduling, such as exam-room assignment. It does NOT by itself block all Task Intelligence functions (such as goal intake, WBS generation, dependency planning, organization/subject context, or general planning using known supported data). Physical room/resource authority remains unresolved; no room capacity or equipment metadata may be invented.

business_confirmation_gates.title: Future Staff Availability vs Historical Attendance Semantics
business_confirmation_gates.schema_fact: Historical daily employee punch logs (staff_attendance) cannot be assumed to represent future operational availability. Timetable free slots != complete availability.
business_confirmation_gates.risk: Treating historical punch logs as forward availability creates severe resource scheduling risk.
business_confirmation_gates.rule: Forward availability is governed exclusively by approved leave (staff_leave_request) and published timetables; historical attendance is excluded from planning.

organization_context.purpose: Provide institutional structure, department hierarchies, and professional designations for task routing and role matching.
organization_context.conditions_for_inclusion: Included when goal requires role-based work decomposition or inter-departmental task routing. Descriptive context only; does not establish individual task capability or eligibility.
organization_context.source_attribution_requirement: Attributed to institutional organization master in upstream ERP.
organization_context.staleness_behavior: High caching tolerance (daily refresh acceptable); invalidate on explicit administrative organizational update.

academic_context.purpose: Provide academic session temporal bounds, target grade classes, sections, and cohort identifiers.
academic_context.conditions_for_inclusion: Mandatory for academic operational goals; scoped strictly to target cohorts identified in goal input.
academic_context.source_attribution_requirement: Attributed to academic session and curriculum masters in upstream ERP.
academic_context.staleness_behavior: Session rarely changes mid-term; high caching tolerance; invalidate on term rollover.

subject_context.purpose: Provide subject master details, codes, instructional types (Theory vs Practical), and curricular groupings.
subject_context.conditions_for_inclusion: Included when goal involves curriculum, examination, lesson planning, or subject-specific work orders.
subject_context.source_attribution_requirement: Attributed to institutional course catalogue and subject masters.
subject_context.staleness_behavior: Curricular definitions are stable per term; cached across planning sessions; refreshed on syllabus change.

staff_resource_context.purpose: Provide sanitized candidate staff roster, descriptive qualifications, work experience, and opaque reference tokens for contextual planning suggestions. Descriptive staff attributes do NOT establish authoritative operational capability or task eligibility.
staff_resource_context.conditions_for_inclusion: Included when goal requires resource candidate matching; filtered to staff matching required designations or departments. Default projection uses opaque staff references; names conditional on explicit workflow requirement. Descriptive attributes provide contextual suggestions only; deterministic validation and/or human review must determine whether a candidate assignment is actually permitted.
staff_resource_context.source_attribution_requirement: Attributed to sanitized staff roster; opaque references mapped to canonical E-7 resource IDs.
staff_resource_context.staleness_behavior: Staff roster cached daily; active employment status verified prior to planning payload dispatch.

commitment_context.purpose: Provide known published teaching timetable periods defining busy intervals for candidate staff and classes.
commitment_context.conditions_for_inclusion: Included when scheduling operational tasks or meetings to avoid timetable collisions. Known periods define busy windows; free slots != complete availability.
commitment_context.source_attribution_requirement: Attributed to published institutional timetable schedule in upstream ERP.
commitment_context.staleness_behavior: Moderate tolerance for caching (session duration); refresh daily or on-demand prior to schedule run.

calendar_context.purpose: Provide informational institutional holiday dates and events for temporal planning awareness.
calendar_context.conditions_for_inclusion: Filtered to calendar dates and events overlapping the active planning operational window. Informational only; hard operational shutdown requires E-7 policy.
calendar_context.source_attribution_requirement: Attributed to institutional academic calendar and public event logs.
calendar_context.staleness_behavior: Refreshed daily or on-demand before planning intake.

aggregate_context.purpose: Provide anonymized student cohort headcounts for operational scale, effort estimation, and staffing ratio planning (individual staff assignment eligibility is not inferred from MySQL).
forbidden_fields: All individual student row attributes, PII, contacts, addresses, medical, and guardian fields
aggregate_context.conditions_for_inclusion: Included when task effort, seating, or material requirements scale with cohort population size. Aggregate disclosure must follow institutional privacy policy; minimum group size or suppression thresholds, if required, must be configurable and approved by business authority; no numeric threshold is hardcoded in this policy.
aggregate_context.source_attribution_requirement: Derived dynamically by ERP adapter aggregation query without storing or exposing individual records.
aggregate_context.staleness_behavior: Computed synchronously during goal intake or cached with short TTL.

failure_modes.description: A query or context builder component attempts to access a table not in the allowed source catalog.
failure_modes.reason: Access to unmapped, unvetted, or arbitrary tables is denied by default.

failure_modes.description: An unexpected or newly added column is returned by the upstream source database.
failure_modes.reason: Unknown columns fail closed and MUST be omitted before context normalization.

failure_modes.description: An existing whitelisted column's data type, nullability, or key constraint has changed in MySQL.
failure_modes.reason: Upstream schema mutation cannot automatically expand or modify the exposure surface.

failure_modes.description: A referenced foreign key cannot be mapped to an internal canonical entity.
failure_modes.reason: Unmapped entities cannot be safely represented in canonical or opaque context.

failure_modes.description: A live production query is attempted without an established tenant or organizational scope partition.
failure_modes.reason: Database iredu lacks multi-tenant partitioning; live production context retrieval remains blocked until authoritative tenant/organization scoping is defined.

failure_modes.description: Retrieved context snapshot exceeds freshness threshold for time-critical planning.
failure_modes.reason: Stale context reduces planning fidelity; marked degraded and planning proceeds only with human override.

failure_modes.description: A required institutional prerequisite (e.g. active academic session, target grade class) is missing.
failure_modes.reason: Core planning context cannot be constructed without foundational entities.

failure_modes.description: A prompt, service, or query requests a restricted, forbidden, or PII field.
failure_modes.reason: Restricted fields are FORBIDDEN_FROM_AI for the current Task Intelligence scope and policy version; MUST emit security audit evidence.

failure_modes.description: A field or table requiring unresolved business confirmation is requested before formal sign-off.
failure_modes.reason: Unconfirmed business fields fail closed and cannot enter model context.

failure_modes.description: Adapter cohort count query fails, times out, returns an invalid mathematical result, or cohort aggregate presents re-identification risk.
failure_modes.reason: Missing cohort headcount degrades effort estimation accuracy; if aggregate presents re-identification risk, action is OMIT_FIELD or REQUIRE_HUMAN_CLARIFICATION without assuming numeric thresholds.

failure_modes.description: Upstream MySQL connection times out, returns connection error, or network partition occurs.
failure_modes.reason: Cannot assemble verified context; silent fallback or synthetic substitution is strictly prohibited.

failure_modes.description: Upstream free-text field contains suspicious instruction-like text, prompt injection patterns, or role overrides.
failure_modes.reason: Suspicious instruction-like text is treated as data, SHOULD be omitted or quarantined from the context payload, and MUST emit security audit evidence.

failure_modes.description: Upstream database contains contradictory records (e.g. overlapping teaching periods for single teacher).
failure_modes.reason: Contradictory upstream data cannot be resolved algorithmically by the Context Builder.

failure_modes.description: An external entity ID cannot be resolved or mapped to a canonical E-7 identifier.
failure_modes.reason: Missing identity mapping prevents linking generated tasks to institutional entities.

audit_requirements: Future Context Builder implementation MUST produce auditable evidence for context assembly operations.
context_request_id: Globally unique identifier correlating the context build request.
goal_id / plan_request_id: Identifier of the active operational goal triggering context assembly.
actor_identity: Authenticated actor or background service identity requesting plan generation.

resolved_tenant_scope: Resolved tenant/organization scope reference ONLY when such scope has been authoritatively established; during synthetic/mock/documentation testing, synthetic/test scope identifiers only; no production tenant identifier is invented.
policy_version: Version of the AI Context Access Policy applied (e.g. 1.0.0).
mapping_version: Version of the MySQL Task Intelligence mapping applied (e.g. 1.2.0).
categories_requested: Array of context categories evaluated for the goal.
categories_included: Array of context categories admitted into the payload.
categories_denied: Array of context categories rejected by policy or goal minimization.
fields_projected_count: Total integer count of whitelisted/projected fields admitted.
fields_redacted_count: Total integer count of restricted/forbidden fields intercepted and omitted.
source_freshness_snapshots: Map of source table names to their last retrieval timestamp or cache age.
model_invocation_correlation_id: Correlation token linking context payload to model telemetry.
audit_storage_rule: Immutable append-only audit evidence emission; raw sensitive payload persistence is NOT required and forbidden raw PII must never be stored.

rules: Any newly discovered column in upstream MySQL MUST be denied by default.
Renamed, dropped, or modified whitelisted columns trigger validation block (FM-03) and require manual policy review.
New upstream tables or views MUST NOT be accessible until evaluated through a formal Task 0G mapping revision.
Production systems MUST NOT dynamically expand the LLM exposure surface based on upstream DDL changes.
Schema cryptographic fingerprinting (DDL hashing) MUST be evaluated during adapter implementation in Phase 1.
